import sys,random,time,resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from crosscheck.common_utils import NetworkTopology
from crosscheck.dtp import DemocraticTrustPropagationRepair

# full physical degree 8 with 128 nodes and 512 links
random.seed(234)
n=128
edges=set()
for i in range(n):
 for j in range(1,5):
  edges.add(tuple(sorted((i,(i+j)%n))))
T={'nodes':[{'id':i,'name':f'N{i}','external_capacity':10**9} for i in range(n)],
   'links':[{'source':a,'target':b,'capacity':10**9} for a,b in edges],
   'external_nodes':[f'N{i}' for i in range(16)]}
top=NetworkTopology(T)
print('F=',len(top.flows))
r=DemocraticTrustPropagationRepair(top,{'trials':32,'epsilon':250000,'seed':2**32-1})
t=time.process_time()
for i in range(7):
 ms=[random.randrange(10**9+1) if random.random()>.1 else None for k in top.counter_keys]
 p=[random.randrange(10**9*4) for f in top.flows]
 c=r.repair(ms,p,True)
 print(i,'cpu',time.process_time()-t,'mem',resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss)
PY
python3 -B tmp/bench_model.py
